title: Starbucks Coffee 16 oz tumbler Cup w/ lid plastic - No Straw (Used)
descriptionText:
Slight discoloration around lid. See pics. Kinda orange. 

This Starbucks coffee tumbler is perfect for any coffee or tea lover! With a 16 oz capacity, it's great for your on-the-go caffeine fix. The tumbler features a green color and Starbucks logo, and is an original piece from 2012. It comes with a lid and is made of plastic, making it durable and long-lasting. This mug is perfect for collectors or anyone who loves Starbucks memorabilia. Add it to your collection today!
